name: Kinoshita Yuyu
source:
Yuyu has been attached to her sheep stuffed animal named Daniel since a very young age. Contrary to her appearance, she enjoys violent movies. She calls [url=/c98202]Himari[/url] "President-chan" and [url=/c98551]Ayame[/url], whom she has a crush on, "Miss Ayame".

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
